nodes.label: Offline scouting and venue mode design (Maneuver batch 4)
Offline scouting
nodes.rationale: Venues have no signal for scouts or the lead; a phone set up online beforehand must open the form, save offline and upload automatically later.

nodes.label: QR transfer
nodes.rationale: Animated fountain-code QR lets scouts hand entries to the lead's laptop without any network; frames can be caught in any order and missed ones don't matter.

nodes.label: Venue laptop
nodes.rationale: Lead needs the last morning's matches within minutes for the pick list, and uses almost every stats page; a local Castle copy keeps one copy of the stats logic.

nodes.label: No double counting
nodes.rationale: Every path that moves entries (phone sync, QR, both file imports) must be safe to repeat; uploading the same entry twice never creates two records.

nodes.label: castle-entries format
nodes.rationale: One JSON envelope serves phone sync, QR and files, so there is a single import path to secure and test.

nodes.label: GET /scouting/export
nodes.rationale: Exports current-season matches the user can see, team pits and public fields of every team member (so a rookie's first entries are accepted on the laptop); never password hashes or emails.

nodes.label: POST /scouting/import
nodes.rationale: Single CSRF-protected, rate-limited, size-capped entry point returning per-entry saved/already_have/duplicate/rejected results.

nodes.label: client_id
nodes.rationale: Stored on add-form records too (the posted _draft_id), so a later sync of the same entry is recognised as already_have.

nodes.label: Already-have rule
nodes.rationale: An entry whose _id or client_id already exists is already_have and nothing is written; this makes every transfer path idempotent. Unindexed lookup marked shortcut since team_data is small.

nodes.label: Scouter attribution rule
nodes.rationale: scouter_id must be the uploader or a teammate, else rejected; credit stays with scouter_id and uploaded_by records the uploader. Teammates can already edit each other's entries.

nodes.label: Incoming _id reuse rule
nodes.rationale: Amended after security review: on the main server an incoming _id/client_id only counts as already_have within the uploader's access_match scope and is never reused for inserts, so uploaders cannot probe other teams' record ids.

nodes.label: Venue mode
nodes.rationale: VENUE_MODE=1 in the laptop's .env switches import to venue behaviour (stubs, exact copies, origin marking) only on the lead's own machine.

nodes.label: Stub users
nodes.rationale: Public-field-only users created from the file's users or a QR scout object (same team only) so pages show scout names, the team check passes and UNWIND_SCOUTER doesn't hide records; they cannot log in. Never created on the main server.

nodes.label: Exact copies
nodes.rationale: Venue-only: entries with an existing _id are stored with their known fields (excluded, keys, client_id, fuel) instead of rebuilt, so the laptop's stats match the main server's.

nodes.label: origin venue marker
nodes.rationale: Records created on the laptop get origin: venue so only they are pushed back, and main-server deletions are never undone.

nodes.label: Cached scout form
nodes.rationale: Service worker caches /scouting/add HTML and serves it only when that navigation fails; logout deletes it because the page bakes in user id and CSRF token.

nodes.label: Schedule cache
nodes.rationale: add.js stores events and matches per user in localStorage (castle:schedule:<user>) and falls back to it when /api/tba/* fails.

nodes.label: Typed match entry
nodes.rationale: User's decision: 'Match not listed? Type it in' builds the same label the dropdown would (Qual N / Semifinal S-M / Final N) so tba_match_key yields the same match_key and the duplicate check still works.

nodes.label: Outbox
nodes.rationale: On network failure entries queue in localStorage castle:outbox:<user> with client_id, scouter_id and created_at; if storage fails the draft is kept. Never lose the entry.

nodes.label: Outbox sync
nodes.rationale: POSTs the outbox to /scouting/import on load, on online and every 60 s; removes saved/already_have/duplicate, keeps rejected with reason, keeps everything on session expiry.

nodes.label: Match13 fuel estimates
nodes.rationale: Scouts don't count fuel; the online AI model Match13 estimates it. Import must enroll zero-scored-fuel entries exactly as add does.

nodes.label: qrf fountain codec
nodes.rationale: Luby Transform with robust soliton distribution, reused from the qrf branch's qrf.js, but not its routes or list-page code.

nodes.label: QR payload id
nodes.rationale: Builder-check fix: each frame carries a payload id and the decoder resets when it changes, so two scouts' codes never mix.

nodes.label: Decoder peeling
nodes.rationale: Builder-check fix: new frames are reduced by already-decoded chunks so decoding finishes in a reasonable number of frames.

nodes.label: Vendored QR libraries
nodes.rationale: qrcodejs 1.0.0 for drawing and jsQR 1.4.0 for scanning are vendored so they work offline; BarcodeDetector used when available.

nodes.label: Show QR panel
nodes.rationale: A panel on the add page so it works offline with no extra cached page; sending by QR does not remove entries from the outbox, which still syncs itself.

nodes.label: Scan page
nodes.rationale: /scouting/scan on the lead's laptop: webcam view with progress, POSTs decoded entries to /scouting/import and shows per-entry results.

nodes.label: Venue setup guide
nodes.rationale: A written step-by-step student guide (docs/venue-mode.md) instead of a one-click installer.

nodes.label: flask venue-user
nodes.rationale: CLI creates the lead's login on the laptop so no password hash ever leaves castlescouting.com.

nodes.label: flask venue-reset
nodes.rationale: Builder-check call: each event starts from a fresh laptop DB so records deleted on castlescouting.com don't come back; refuses while unpushed origin venue records exist unless --force.

nodes.label: Download new entries
nodes.rationale: Exports ?scope=venue (only laptop-created entries) after the event and records the push timestamp; main-server deletions are never undone.

nodes.label: fuel_pending flag
nodes.rationale: Match13 needs internet, so laptop-created zero-fuel entries are flagged and left out of fuel averages; otherwise $avg over $ifNull[...,0] would count them as 0.

nodes.label: Vendored CDN scripts
nodes.rationale: Every CDN script the lead and scouts' pages load (localforage, chart.js, sortablejs, popper) is vendored and pinned; localforage is needed or Canvas.js crashes the offline form.

nodes.label: Working without TBA
nodes.rationale: Pages the lead uses must render with no network: guard get_team returning None in /api/compare, fail-fast TBA/Statbotics timeouts, number search on compare.

nodes.label: Venue mode banner
nodes.rationale: Banner 'Venue mode: local copy, not castlescouting.com' so nobody confuses the two.

nodes.label: Approach A: stats pages rebuilt on phone
nodes.rationale: Rejected: how Maneuver works; four+ pages built twice and numbers drift when a formula changes on one side.

nodes.label: Approach B: laptop runs its own Castle
nodes.rationale: Chosen: every page works unchanged with one copy of stats logic; costs a one-time Python+MongoDB setup, a night-before file step and scouts walking to the laptop.

nodes.label: Approach C: cache pages the night before
nodes.rationale: Rejected: the leaderboard would miss the last morning's matches, which are exactly what picking needs.

nodes.label: Anti-goal: spoofing
nodes.rationale: Any team member creating entries as another team's scout or setting fields the add form can't; the old qrf branch import accepted raw documents and had this problem.

nodes.label: Anti-goal: wrong user on a shared phone
Anti-goal: broken page
nodes.rationale: /api/compare does TBAInterface().get_team(...).get(...) with no None guard (lighthouse.py:70-73).

nodes.label: Team Wi-Fi transfer (non-goal)
nodes.rationale: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and WebRTC transfer excluded because FIRST event rules are believed to ban team-run Wi-Fi at venues (unconfirmed).
